text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I join Fine Motion on a trip to "observe"
the
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, everyone sounds so lively! Do you
think
there's a festival?!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! A raffle!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And anyone can participate! Can I try,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pass Fine Motion the raffle ticket we
received
when we bought some
croquettes a short time
ago.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, sir. May I participate in your
raffle?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ah... Of course! P-please go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion gives the raffle machine's
lever a
vigorous spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A hot spring vacation?! I'm so happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Japanese hot springs are great, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Sometimes I go to public baths with
my
friends!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We have bathtubs in the castle, of course, but I didn't know the true value of a relaxing soak until I came to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The best part is definitely the chance to
speak
with many people from the dorms
or around town.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I have no doubt that going to this
hot
spring will be a splendid experience.
When should
we—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I think it's actually best if I give this to
you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This coupon is only valid for a limited
time, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I may not be able to go. I'd rather you
use it than
let it go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Good. Now, make sure you enjoy it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion seems to have fully given
up on the
idea of going on a hot spring
vacation. However...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: 次は俺が特賞を当ててプレゼントする
次は私が特賞を当ててプレゼントする

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If that day comes, I'll make sure you
take me with
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee either of us can
keep this
promise. However, I believe
the day will surely
come.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it must be delicious if they
deemed it
worthy of the "deluxe" label.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry and eat it, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This hamburger steak is so scrumptious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's incredibly juicy even though we only
barely
reheated it! I'm sure it must have
been made using
a legendary culinary
technique.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you summon the chef that
made
this hamburger steak?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have so many things I'd like to discuss
with them.
My own chef could learn a
lot, as well, so if it's no
trouble, I'd like
to have a conference call.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm, yes, let's set up a place to dine
together.
Captain?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things are escalating rather quickly, but
Fine
Motion appears quite pleased.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! There must be a whole field's
worth of
carrots in here!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm, you're right... but we need to be
sure to eat
them while they're still at
their tastiest.
choice_data_list: すぐには食べきれなそうだな
すぐには食べきれなそうだね

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Why don't we hold a potluck with
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Fine! The carrot cake's ready!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ...Mmm, it smells great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
My carrot salad is done too. Cooking
really is just
so fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know, right? ♪ I tried out
something new
as well!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I call it... carrot ramen! It's piping hot,
straight out
of the kitchen. ♪

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wonderous! What a shiny carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm really sorry... I can only give you
one.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Why are you apologizing? The
quality is
what's most important.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This carrot was grown with the utmost
care—it's
like a single precious jewel.
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I accept it graciously. ♪

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: She's so dignified!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, would this count as a cheeky snack?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Here, you can have half, Trainer. ♪
Hehe, let's
see who can finish faster!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Bad luck!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, this was still a new experience
for
me! ♪ I'll use each one gladly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You're up next, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then everyone in my security team... Oh,
should I
invite my friends too?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, I really want to see
someone
win!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, really? Oh well...
